datasets.name: MILUV: Multi-UAV Indoor Localization dataset with UWB and Vision
datasets.notes: Paper describes 217 minutes, 36 experiments, three UAVs, UWB raw timestamps/CIR, stereo and monocular cameras, IMU, laser height, magnetometer and motion-capture ground truth. Exact downloaded file set and hashes, per-sensor time alignment, frame transforms, calibration artifacts and held-out experiment split still need review.

datasets.name: UrbanNav Hong Kong urban-canyon multisensor dataset
datasets.notes: Official repository states MIT terms include dataset files. Candidate tracks include medium/deep/harsh urban and tunnel. Some pilot data lacks hardware synchronization; some sequences have ground-truth gaps or calibration omissions. Select an exact sequence and verify that sequence-specific limitations are acceptable.

datasets.name: Tank underwater multisensor SLAM evaluation dataset
datasets.notes: Eight controlled tank sequences with stereo, IMU, DVL, depth pressure and fiducial-marker-based 6-DoF ground truth. Official page limits use to non-commercial academic research under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Excluded from commercial benchmark or commercial product paths unless separately licensed.

datasets.name: SubT-MRS multi-robot subterranean SLAM dataset
datasets.notes: Candidate real-world multi-platform RGB/LiDAR/thermal/IMU dataset with cave, tunnel and adverse-visibility conditions. No dataset payload rights are asserted here; obtain exact license and sequence-specific ground-truth/calibration details before admission.

datasets.name: HK-UrbanSpoof: urban GPS L1 synchronous spoofing and GNSS/INS reference dataset
datasets.notes: Candidate only. GitHub repo main commit 95def2b6a42eee6299bbc1a5b880a9f3bfc070d6; README blob feda2d04eb801862539164561a1315ca450eee02. Repository has no LICENSE file and GitHub API license=null. Raw IF files are external Google Drive objects, not pinned in the Git repository; no SHA-256 file inventory is recorded. S2_GT.txt and S3_GT.txt are present in the repository; README describes them as time-tagged post-processed GNSS/INS position, velocity and attitude, but timestamp/clock and oracle independence require review. README still says ray-tracing labels are coming soon and retains an older ground-truth-release sentence despite the present S2/S3 files. S1/S2/S3 are real-source scenarios; S4 is simulated and uses a different IF configuration and must be evaluated separately. Public download availability is not a data licence; obtain author confirmation for research, commercial use and redistribution before admission.

datasets.name: UrbanNav-HK-Medium-Urban-1 multisensor urban navigation sequence
datasets.notes: Rights are explicitly stated by the upstream README: the MIT licence covers the dataset files provided by the README download links (ROS bags, GNSS RINEX, IMU and ground-truth files), including commercial use and redistribution with notices. Snapshot is only the repository commit, not the downloaded dataset payload. Recommended first segment: UrbanNav-HK-Medium-Urban-1 (33.7 GB, 785 s, 3.64 km; GNSS, IMU, LiDAR, stereo camera; SPAN-CPT + IE ground truth; raw RINEX v3.02; ROS TimeReference topic). All download files remain un-hashed, so payload snapshot is not immutable. Upstream README reports a malfunctioning u-blox F9P receiver during a particular interval (upstream issue #11); exclude or explicitly label that interval. The broader repository also contains Deep, Harsh and Tunnel routes; the Harsh route has only partial verified ground truth and must not be assumed fully covered. SPAN-CPT/IE ground truth is 1 Hz, lower than 400 Hz IMU; time alignment, frame/extrinsic calibration and oracle lineage must be qualified for the chosen route. Tokyo data lack LiDAR extrinsic calibration in the README and is not the first target. This record remains candidate_not_admitted pending exact payload hashes, subset split, calibration/time/frame audit, and ground-truth review.

datasets.name: Hilti-Trimble-Oxford 360-degree visual-inertial SLAM and floor-plan localization benchmark
datasets.notes: Non-commercial research candidate only. Official challenge repository pinned at commit 655df637120786621be8ffb14c4ee367abfee85a; repository LICENSE and official challenge site specify CC BY-NC-SA 3.0, so no commercial product, commercial dataset use or incompatible redistribution is permitted without separate authorization. Thirty 360-degree visual-inertial sequences span ten floors over an eight-month active construction project. Released data are ROS 2 bags with two 30 Hz fisheye camera streams and 1 kHz IMU, plus floor-plan priors and per-run ground-truth trajectories. Camera/IMU calibration files are supplied. Ground truth is produced by a rigidly attached Hesai XT32 LiDAR-inertial system, but raw LiDAR data are not released; the reference is therefore not an independently reprocessable oracle from the distributed payload. The Insta360 camera and reference LiDAR-inertial device use separate timing systems: alignment is estimated from gyro-norm correlation, nonlinear time-offset/clock-scale refinement and joint gyro-bias optimization. The published constant timestamp shift of 1e4 seconds and first-five-seconds exclusion must be preserved exactly. The official leaderboard evaluates 25 SLAM runs / 24 floorplan-localization runs, requires at least 99% trajectory coverage and scores per-pose error exponentially; this is useful as an industry baseline, but the proposed integrity extension must additionally evaluate false-safe exposure, drift, failure detection and recovery. Hugging Face payload objects and per-file hashes are not frozen in this registry; do not admit until exact payload snapshot, calibration/time review, sequence-level split and truth-oracle review are complete.
